sources.name: Unicode Standard Annex #9: Unicode Bidirectional Algorithm

provenance.notes: Written in this phase from the cited references and re-expressed; the Arabic text is the researcher's own wording and needs a native reviewer. The checks are proposals for the harness, not yet run.

title.ar: اقبل الرقم كما يكتبه الناس ولا تُصلح ما هو ملتبس
title.en: Accept a number as people write it; do not repair what is ambiguous

statement.ar: اقبل الأرقام بأي نظام والمسافات والشرطات والنقاط والأقواس و«+» و«00» والصفر المحلي أو غيابه، وعلامات الاتجاه الملصوقة. ما لا يمكن تحديده دون تخمين (بلد غير البلد المحدد، صفر زائد بعد رمز البلد، حروف) يُرفض برسالة تشرح.
statement.en: Accept digits of any system, spaces, dashes, dots, parentheses, "+", "00", the national leading zero or its absence, and pasted direction marks. What cannot be determined without guessing (a country other than the selected one, an extra zero after the country code, letters) is rejected with an explanation.

rationale.ar: الناس ينسخون الأرقام من جهات الاتصال والرسائل بصيغ لا حصر لها. لكن إصلاح رقم ملتبس بصمت يرسل رمز تحقق إلى شخص آخر.
rationale.en: People copy numbers from contacts and messages in endless formats. But silently repairing an ambiguous number sends a verification code to someone else.

checks: phone-inputs cases with region EG pass (27 cases) and phones-harvested passes (6 cases).
A number is never accepted after removing a character other than the listed formatting characters and bidi controls.
The rejection message for a wrong country names the expected country or prefix.
